dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline curvature along the trailing edge, originating from the posterior dorsal ridge to the fin apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius at the maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical pixel height is approximately 1.1 times the horizontal base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a uniform radius defining the anterior-dorsal cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak geometry with a low length-to-base-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the melon-rostrum transition point.

other_distinctive_markers: Homogeneous cyan-luminescent surface texture and low-polygon geometric construction.
